newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Yield on Swiss six-month claims falls to 1.382 pct.
newsitem.headline: Yield on Swiss six-month claims falls to 1.382 pct.

text.p: The average annual yield on the latest issue of Swiss federal government six-month money market claims fell to 1.382 percent from the previous issue's yield of 1.629 percent, the Swiss National Bank said.
Series 6.390 raised 832.75 million francs and was priced at 99.306 percent. Pay date is June 12.
An issue paid for on May 1 raised 985.90 million and was priced at 99.183 percent.
